summary.text: Sylvia Wayfer Baker was first elected to Georgia House District 64 in 2024 and was sworn in on January 13, 2025.

paragraphs.text: The district includes a portion of Douglas County.
The General Assembly's member page lists her occupation as attorney and her residence as Douglasville.

sources.title: Rep. Sylvia Wayfer Baker Sworn in, Receives Committee Assignments for the 2025-2026 Legislative Term
